name: Buff: Force
effect: Add $lowDamage to the target's first Strike each turn if it hits.

name: Buff: Guard
effect: The target gains temporary Hit Points equal to $moderateDamage.

name: Buff: Motion
effect: The target gains a +15-foot status bonus to its Speeds.

name: Repelling Strike
effect: Make a ranged Strike. On a failed Fortitude save, the target is pushed 10 feet away from you.

name: Escalating Strike
effect: Make a melee Strike. If you hit the target with Escalating Strike during the previous round, it deals $extremeDamage instead of the listed damage.

name: Hazardous Scatter
effect: The squares become difficult terrain. A creature moving on the ground takes 1 $nonphysicalDamageType damage for each square it enters.

name: Elemental Upheaval
effect: Creatures in the area take $lowDamage, subject to the saving throw. The ground becomes difficult, hazardous terrain; a creature moving through it takes $terribleDamage for each square it enters. You are immune to this ability's effects.

name: Set Instant Trap
effect: Build an instant trap on the target square.

name: Set Prepared Trap
target: One object that can be opened
effect: When battle starts, a prepared trap has already been set on an object.

name: Set Mine
effect: Build a mine on the target square.

name: Thrown Burst
effect: Lob an attack into the area; you don't need line of sight to the area. Creatures in it take the listed damage, subject to the saving throw.

name: Final Burst
trigger: You are reduced to 0 Hit Points.
effect: Creatures in the area take the listed damage, subject to the saving throw.

name: Aim and Fire Artillery
effect:
Select a grid intersection within range and mark it for an artillery attack; line of sight is not required. The targeted area is visibly indicated, and all combatants know which area will be affected.

At the start of your next turn, the attack resolves at the designated location. Creatures in the area take the listed damage, subject to the saving throw.

name: Pariah Aura
effect: Any creature other than you that starts its turn in the aura becomes a Lifelink recipient, with you as its donor. Each new link increases your stunned value by 1.

name: Put In the Crosshairs
effect: Designate one creature as your target. That creature gains the In the Crosshairs status.

name: Sniper Strike
requirements: The target is affected by In the Crosshairs; your weapon is loaded; Reload 1.
effect: Make a ranged Strike using the listed statistics. On a hit, deal additional precision damage equal to $lowDamage.

name: Blood Curse
effect: The target takes the listed persistent bleed damage with a basic Will save.

name: Battle-Mad Swing
frequency: Once per turn, required every turn
effect:
Randomly select an adjacent creature, ally or enemy, and make a melee Strike against it. If no creatures are adjacent, swing at empty air.

This Strike neither takes nor increases your multiple attack penalty.

name: Mindless Rush
frequency: Once per turn, required every turn
effect: Stride up to $speed toward the nearest enemy to which you are not already adjacent, taking the shortest available route. If no such enemy exists, do not move.

name: Overwatch
trigger: A creature within 30 feet begins an action with the move trait.
requirements: You can make a ranged Strike against the triggering creature.
effect: Make a ranged Strike against the creature before it moves.

name: Downed Prey
effect: Your melee Strikes against prone creatures deal additional precision damage equal to $lowDamage on a hit.

name: Guardian Field
effect: At the start of each ally's turn, if that ally is in the aura, it gains temporary Hit Points equal to $lowDamage. A creature can gain them from this ability only once per round.

name: Overcommitted Slam
effect: You also deal $meleeDamage $meleeDamageType damage to creatures in the cone (basic Reflex save against DC $abilityDC). After your attack, you fall prone and become slowed 1 and stunned 3.

name: Shared Veil
duration: Until the start of your next turn or until after the target takes a hostile action.
target: One willing creature you can see.
effect: The target can make a Hide check as a reaction.

name: Chosen Rival
effect: The first time each turn you hit the chosen creature with a melee Strike, you deal additional $lowDamage. You have resistance to damage from every other creature equal to $minimumResistance. Choosing a new rival ends this effect.

name: Shadow Prowl
duration: The Hidden condition lasts until the start of your next turn or until after you make a Strike, whichever comes first.
effect: Stride up to $speed. You can make a Hide check as a free action at the end of this movement.

name: Isolated Prey
effect: Melee Strikes against enemies that are off-guard and have no adjacent allies deal additional precision damage equal to $lowDamage.

name: Aegis Ward
effect:
Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic when you cast the spell. You and your allies within the aura gain a +1 status bonus to AC, saving throws, and attack rolls, and resistance 5 to the chosen damage type.

You must Sustain the spell.

name: Breaching Strikes
effect: Creatures you hit with a Strike take a –3 penalty to AC. This penalty does not stack.

name: Abduct
requirements: You have at least one creature grabbed.
effect: Stride up to $halfSpeed, pulling any creatures you have grabbed along with you.

name: Minion Master
effect: Create one minion in the target square. Your minions take their turns immediately after you.

name: Fiery Rebuke
trigger: A creature within 30 feet damages you.
effect: The triggering creature takes the listed damage, subject to the saving throw.

name: Delayed Magic Missile
effect: Fire a dart for each opponent you can see. At the start of the next turn, each dart automatically hits its assigned target and deals $terribleDamage force damage.

name: Leaping Knockdown
effect:
Leap, ignoring difficult terrain; this movement does not trigger reactions. Attempt Athletics ($athletics) against the target’s Reflex DC. This attack uses your current multiple attack penalty and increases it. Critical Success: Target falls prone; no extra damage.
Success: Target falls prone.
Failure: No effect.
Critical Failure: You fall prone.

name: Breach Ram
target: One creature in a straight path
effect: Stride at least $halfSpeed and up to $speed in a straight line. If you end adjacent to a creature, make a melee Strike against it. On a hit, the target attempts the saving throw; failure pushes it 5 feet.

name: Mirror Image
effect: Create three illusory doubles in your space. When an attack would hit you, randomly determine whether it hits you or a remaining double, with each equally likely. A double struck by an attack disappears. A failed attack that is not a critical failure removes one double and has no other effect. If a critical hit is assigned to a double, remove that double and resolve a normal hit against you instead. The spell ends when the last double disappears.

name: Disarm
target: One item held by a creature
effect:
Attempt Athletics ($athletics) against the holder’s Reflex DC. This attack uses your current multiple attack penalty and increases it.
Critical Success: The item falls into the holder’s space.
Success: The holder’s grip weakens. Further Disarm attempts against this item gain a +2 circumstance bonus; the holder takes a −2 circumstance penalty to attacks with it and checks needing a firm grip. The holder can Interact to readjust its grip; otherwise this lasts while it holds the item.
Failure: No effect.
Critical Failure: You are off-guard until the start of your next turn.

name: Translocate
target: You and your worn and held items.
effect: Teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within range, bringing your worn and held items. The spell fails if another creature would travel with you, including one inside an extradimensional container.

name: Breathe Fire
effect:
A gout of flame sprays from your mouth. You deal 2d6 fire damage to creatures in the area with a basic Reflex save.
Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

name: Revealing Light
effect: Each creature attempts a Reflex save. Critical success: unaffected. Success: affected for 2 rounds. Failure: affected for 1 minute. Critical failure: affected for 10 minutes. An affected creature is dazzled. If invisible, it becomes concealed instead; concealment from other causes is removed.

name: Dispel Magic
target: One spell effect or unattended magic item.
effect: Attempt a counteract check against the target using your spellcasting modifier ($spellAttack) and effective spell rank. Success counteracts the spell effect or suppresses a magic item's magic for 10 minutes, leaving its mundane properties intact. Attempts against artifacts and similar items automatically fail. Use the normal counteract rules to determine which ranks your check can affect.

name: Reactive Strike
trigger: A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using
effect: The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

name: Tactical Reflexes
effect: When you regain your actions at the start of your turn, gain one additional reaction usable only for Reactive Strike.

name: Heal
traits: Healing, Manipulate, Vitality; Concentrate with two or three actions
target: One willing living creature or one undead; all living and undead creatures in the area with three actions.
range: Touch with one action; 30 feet with two actions
damage_type: vitality (damage to undead; healing to willing living creatures)
effect: Use spell rank equal to half your level rounded up, minimum 1 and maximum 10. One action: touch one target, restoring the listed HP to a willing living creature or dealing the listed vitality damage to an undead creature with a basic Fortitude save. Two actions: target one creature within 30 feet; add $healBonus HP when healing a living creature. Three actions: affect all living and undead creatures in a 30-foot emanation, healing living creatures and damaging undead with the listed dice; undead attempt a basic Fortitude save. The dice are 1d8 per rank; the two-action healing bonus is 8 per rank.

name: Dazzling Flash
traits: Cleric, Concentrate, Focus, Light, Manipulate, Visual
effect:
Raise your religious symbol to emit a flash. Each creature attempts a Fortitude save.
Critical Success: Unaffected.
Success: Dazzled for 1 round.
Failure: Blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute; an Interact action to rub its eyes ends the blindness.
Critical Failure: Blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 hour.

name: Glancing Blow
effect: Creatures in the area take the listed damage with a basic Reflex save.

name: Glancing Shot
effect: The target takes the listed damage with a basic Reflex save.

name: Sustain
effect: Choose one of your effects with a sustained duration or one that lists a special benefit when you Sustain it. An effect with a sustained duration continues until the end of your next turn; using Sustain more than once in the same turn does not extend it further. If an effect can be Sustained but gives no duration, it lasts for up to 10 minutes. Sustain also grants any special benefit listed by the effect. If the Sustain action is disrupted, the effect ends.

name: Grapple
effect:
Attempt Athletics ($athletics) against the target’s Fortitude DC. This attack uses your current multiple attack penalty and increases it. To keep a hold, spend another action before it expires and repeat this check; use the new result. A hold ends if you move or the target Escapes.
Critical Success: Target is restrained until the end of your next turn.
Success: Target is grabbed until the end of your next turn.
Failure: No new hold; if you already held the target with Grapple, that hold ends.
Critical Failure: Any Grapple hold you had on the target ends. The target chooses: you become grabbed by it until the end of its next turn (or until it moves or you Escape), or you fall prone.

name: Friendly Teleport
target: Another willing creature you can see in range.
effect: Teleport the target to an unoccupied square within range.

name: Prone
monster: Assassin; Bastion; Cataphract; Demolisher; Ronin; Sentinel
effect: The creature takes a −2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and is off-guard. It can use only Crawl or Stand as move actions. Crawl moves it 5 feet if its Speed is at least 10 feet; Stand ends prone. It can Take Cover while prone for a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against ranged attacks, even without cover, but remains off-guard. A creature knocked prone while climbing or flying falls; a swimming creature cannot be knocked prone.

name: Swap
target: Two willing creatures you can see in range, including yourself.
effect: Teleport the two targets, swapping their positions.

name: Lifelink Donor
effect: Whenever a linked recipient would take damage, you take half that damage instead. Transferred damage cannot be transferred again. Whenever you would regain HP, divide that healing equally among you and all linked recipients, rounding fractions down and giving any remainder to you. A link ends immediately when a recipient moves more than 60 feet from you.

name: Grabbed
effect: The creature is off-guard and immobilized. A manipulate action requires a DC 5 flat check after the action is spent and before it takes effect; on a failure, the action is lost.

name: Lifelink Recipient
effect: You are linked to a donor. Whenever you would take damage, the donor takes half that damage instead. Whenever the donor would regain HP, that healing is divided equally among the donor and all linked recipients.

name: In the Crosshairs
effect:
Sniper Strike is empowered.
When you Take Cover, you can attempt a Reflex save against the Sniper’s ability DC; on a success, this status ends. If the Sniper designates a new target, this status ends.

name: Berserker Rage
duration: 1 minute, until you fall unconscious, or until the encounter ends
effect: You gain temporary Hit Points equal to $lowDamage. While raging, you must use Mindless Rush and Battle-Mad Swing once each every turn, in either order, whenever able.

name: Hidden
effect:
While you're hidden from a creature, that creature knows the space you're in but can't tell precisely where you are. You typically become hidden by using Stealth to Hide. When Seeking a creature using only imprecise senses, it remains hidden, rather than Observed. A creature you're hidden from is Off-Guard to you, and it must succeed at a DC 11 flat check when targeting you with an attack, spell, or other effect or it fails to affect you. Area effects aren't subject to this flat check.

A creature might be able to use the Seek action to try to observe you.

name: Trip
effect:
Attempt Athletics ($athletics) against the target’s Reflex DC. This attack uses your current multiple attack penalty and increases it.
Critical Success: Target falls prone and takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage.
Success: Target falls prone.
Failure: No effect.
Critical Failure: You fall prone.

name: Advanced Trip
requirements: Your last action was a successful Strike against the target.
effect:
Attempt Athletics ($athletics) against the target’s Reflex DC. This check ignores your multiple attack penalty and does not increase it.
Critical Success: Target falls prone and takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage.
Success: Target falls prone.
Failure: No effect.
Critical Failure: You fall prone.

name: Supreme Trip
trigger: Your first Strike on this turn hits the target.
effect:
Attempt Athletics ($athletics) against the target’s Reflex DC. This check ignores your multiple attack penalty and does not increase it.
Critical Success: Target falls prone and takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage.
Success: Target falls prone.
Failure: No effect.
Critical Failure: You fall prone.

name: Advanced Grapple
requirements: Your last action was a successful Strike against the target.
effect:
Attempt Athletics ($athletics) against the target’s Fortitude DC. This check ignores your multiple attack penalty and does not increase it. A hold ends if you move or the target Escapes.
Critical Success: Target is restrained until the end of your next turn.
Success: Target is grabbed until the end of your next turn.
Failure: No new hold; if you already held the target with Grapple, that hold ends.
Critical Failure: Any Grapple hold you had on the target ends. The target chooses: you become grabbed by it until the end of its next turn (or until it moves or you Escape), or you fall prone.

name: Supreme Grapple
trigger: Your first Strike on this turn hits the target.
effect:
Attempt Athletics ($athletics) against the target’s Fortitude DC. This check ignores your multiple attack penalty and does not increase it. A hold ends if you move or the target Escapes.
Critical Success: Target is restrained until the end of your next turn.
Success: Target is grabbed until the end of your next turn.
Failure: No new hold; if you already held the target with Grapple, that hold ends.
Critical Failure: Any Grapple hold you had on the target ends. The target chooses: you become grabbed by it until the end of its next turn (or until it moves or you Escape), or you fall prone.

name: Shove
effect:
Attempt Athletics ($athletics) against the target’s Fortitude DC. This attack uses your current multiple attack penalty and increases it.
Critical Success: Push the target up to 10 feet away. You may Stride after it the same distance and direction.
Success: Push the target 5 feet away. You may Stride after it the same distance and direction.
Failure: No effect.
Critical Failure: You fall prone.

name: Advanced Shove
requirements: Your last action was a successful Strike against the target.
effect:
Attempt Athletics ($athletics) against the target’s Fortitude DC. This check ignores your multiple attack penalty and does not increase it.
Critical Success: Push the target up to 10 feet away. You may Stride after it the same distance and direction.
Success: Push the target 5 feet away. You may Stride after it the same distance and direction.
Failure: No effect.
Critical Failure: You fall prone.

name: Supreme Shove
trigger: Your first Strike on this turn hits the target.
effect:
Attempt Athletics ($athletics) against the target’s Fortitude DC. This check ignores your multiple attack penalty and does not increase it.
Critical Success: Push the target up to 10 feet away. You may Stride after it the same distance and direction.
Success: Push the target 5 feet away. You may Stride after it the same distance and direction.
Failure: No effect.
Critical Failure: You fall prone.

name: Advanced Disarm
requirements: Your last action was a successful Strike against the creature holding the target item.
target: One item held by a creature
effect:
Attempt Athletics ($athletics) against the holder’s Reflex DC. This check ignores your multiple attack penalty and does not increase it.
Critical Success: The item falls into the holder’s space.
Success: The holder’s grip weakens. Further Disarm attempts against this item gain a +2 circumstance bonus; the holder takes a −2 circumstance penalty to attacks with it and checks needing a firm grip. The holder can Interact to readjust its grip; otherwise this lasts while it holds the item.
Failure: No effect.
Critical Failure: You are off-guard until the start of your next turn.

name: Supreme Disarm
trigger: Your first Strike on this turn hits the creature holding the target item.
target: One item held by a creature
effect:
Attempt Athletics ($athletics) against the holder’s Reflex DC. This check ignores your multiple attack penalty and does not increase it.
Critical Success: The item falls into the holder’s space.
Success: The holder’s grip weakens. Further Disarm attempts against this item gain a +2 circumstance bonus; the holder takes a −2 circumstance penalty to attacks with it and checks needing a firm grip. The holder can Interact to readjust its grip; otherwise this lasts while it holds the item.
Failure: No effect.
Critical Failure: You are off-guard until the start of your next turn.

name: Advanced Maintain Grapple
requirements: You have the target grabbed or restrained with Advanced Grapple.
effect: Extend the target’s existing grabbed or restrained condition until the end of your next turn.

name: Supreme Maintain Grapple
requirements: You have the target grabbed or restrained with Supreme Grapple.
effect: Extend the target’s existing grabbed or restrained condition until the end of your next turn.

name: Restrained
effect: The creature is off-guard and immobilized. It cannot use attack or manipulate actions except Escape or Force Open its bonds. Restrained overrides grabbed.

name: Off-Guard
effect: The creature takes a −2 circumstance penalty to AC. Unless the causing effect limits who benefits, this applies against everyone.

name: Escape (PC Response)
effect:
A grabbed, immobilized, or restrained PC can spend one action to attempt Escape from one effect holding them. This has the attack trait: their multiple attack penalty applies and increases. They choose their unarmed attack modifier, Athletics, or Acrobatics against this monster’s Athletics DC ($athleticsDC).
Critical Success: End grabbed, immobilized, and restrained from the chosen effect, then Stride up to 5 feet.
Success: End those conditions from the chosen effect.
Failure: Remain held.
Critical Failure: Remain held and cannot attempt Escape again until their next turn.

name: Immobilized
effect: The creature cannot use actions with the move trait. If an outside force would move it from its space, that force must pass a check against the holding effect’s DC or the holder’s relevant defense, usually Fortitude DC.

name: Dazzled
effect: If vision is the creature’s only precise sense, every creature and object is concealed from it. A concealed target requires a DC 5 flat check to affect with an attack, spell, or other targeted effect; area effects bypass this check.

name: Blinded
effect: The creature cannot see or detect anything by sight. Normal terrain is difficult terrain for it. It critically fails Perception checks that require sight and, if sight is its only precise sense, takes a −4 status penalty to Perception checks. It is immune to visual effects. Blinded overrides dazzled.

name: Concealed
effect: A creature targeting the concealed creature with an attack, spell, or other effect must first pass a DC 5 flat check or the effect misses it. Area effects do not require this check. Concealment can apply against some observers but not others.

name: Invisible
effect: The creature cannot be seen. An observer usually does not know its space (undetected); an observer who saw it become invisible knows its space but cannot see it (hidden). A successful Seek can make it hidden to that observer. It cannot become observed while invisible except through a special ability or magic.

name: Undetected
effect: An observer does not know the creature’s space and cannot target it directly without guessing a square. A guessed attack requires a secret DC 11 flat check as for a hidden target; the GM does not reveal whether the square or roll was wrong. Area effects can still affect it, and an observer can Seek. The observer is off-guard to the undetected creature.

name: Stunned
effect: The creature cannot act while stunned. When it regains actions, reduce the actions regained by its stunned value, then reduce that value by the actions lost. A duration-based stunned effect denies actions for its duration.

name: Slowed
effect: When the creature regains actions at the start of its turn, reduce the number it regains by its slowed value. Slowed 1 means one fewer action each turn while the condition lasts. Gaining slowed during a turn does not reduce actions already gained that turn.

name: Hide
requirements: You are behind standard cover OR otherwise concealed.
effect:
Roll a Secret stealth check against every visible enemy's perception.
Add a +2 or +4 circumstance bonus if you have standard or greater cover.
You have the Hidden status against every enemy you beat.

name: Sneak
effect:
Stride up to half your Speed.

At the end of your move, make a Stealth check against every enemy's Perception that you have standard cover OR concealment against, and that you were previously Hidden or Undetected from.

Success: You become Undetected to those enemies.
Failure: You become Hidden to those enemies.
Critical Failure: You become Observed to those enemies, unless you are Invisible, in which case you become Hidden.

name: Unnoticed
effect: A creature you are unnoticed by has no idea you are present. You are also undetected by it.

name: Observed
effect: An observer knows where you are and can perceive you with a precise sense. Hide can make you hidden; Sneak can make you undetected.

name: Lying in Wait
effect: The Assassin starts combat Unnoticed.

name: Breaking Stealth (PC Response)
effect:
If you Strike an enemy, you still get the Offguard bonus, but you become Observed.
If you take any other action except Hide, Sneak, or Step, you become Observed.
Seek can detect hidden creatures.
